$comment: NOT an npm lockfile. Auditable record of the Soberanía runtime artifacts Frontera vendors for the private pilot (FRONTERA-SOBE-PILOT-01A, updated by FRONTERA-SOBE-PILOT-01C0). It authorizes nothing by itself. Since 01C0 the artifacts are installed as production dependencies through the private closure workspace packages/soberania-runtime-closure (package-lock.json must match the integrity below); no Frontera source consumes them yet, and the published @aoc-enterprise/runtime artifact neither depends on nor carries them. Validate with `npm run check:soberania-runtime-lock`; see docs/integration/SOBERANIA_RUNTIME_CONSUMPTION.md.
sourceNote: Public main of Soberanía Protocol after the squash merge of PR #396 (SOBE-TYPES-01: authorization-runtime declarations no longer import audit-runtime or trust-registry-runtime). Tree identical to the qualified PR head 74f901c25a4c867219994d79752fc6d899b02309; merged by the founder through an organization-admin ruleset bypass with no approving review. Relative to the previous pin (1112c63), only @aoc-runtime/authorization-runtime changed, and its dist/index.js is byte-identical; the other six artifacts repack byte-identically. The repository's root package `aoc-runtime` is not certified for distribution and is not vendored.

packaging.method: npm pack --pack-destination <dir> ./<package dir>, for each package below, from a clean checkout of sourceCommit after npm ci and npm run build

protocolDependency.note: The only Protocol subpath the runtime closure loads. It stays an internal dependency (protocol-consumer.lock.json -> internalDependencySubpaths); Frontera source still may not import it.

allowedRuntimeRequiresNote: Policy, enforced by ALLOWED_RUNTIME_REQUIRES in scripts/soberania-runtime/lib-runtime-artifacts.mjs: an approved runtime package may require another approved runtime package, the internal Protocol canonical subpath, or node:crypto, and nothing else. What each artifact actually requires is recorded per package in runtimeRequires.

excludedPackages.name: aoc-runtime
excludedPackages.reason: Root package of the Soberanía repository; not certified for distribution (declared exports are never built).

excludedPackages.name: @aoc-runtime/trust-registry-runtime
excludedPackages.reason: Trust registry / federation surface; re-exports @aoc/enterprise/assurance/trust (trust service, payout KYC). Not approved for the pilot.

excludedPackages.name: @aoc-runtime/audit-runtime
excludedPackages.reason: Compatibility wrapper over @aoc/enterprise/assurance/audit; would pull @aoc/enterprise into the closure. Its AuditRuntime only annotates a finalized decision and makes no security decision.

excludedPackages.name: @aoc/enterprise
excludedPackages.reason: Contains the excluded assurance/trust surface (trust service, payout KYC) alongside audit; not approved for the pilot.

excludedPackages.name: @aoc-runtime/portable-cognition
excludedPackages.reason: Portable Cognition is excluded from the pilot.

excludedPackages.name: @aoc-runtime/vault-runtime
excludedPackages.reason: Not part of the approved authorization closure.

excludedPackages.name: @aoc-runtime/pmfreak-adapter
excludedPackages.reason: Not part of the approved authorization closure.

resolvedDeclarationGaps.resolvedBy: Soberanía Protocol PR #396, merge commit e85cf1bbb76e844fee7ff6ad5dd5389d26a5f180
resolvedDeclarationGaps.resolution: The constructor's audit and federated-verifier parameters are typed by structural ports declared in the package itself (AuthorizationDecisionFinalizer, FederatedAuthorityVerifierPort). The declarations import only approved closure packages, and a strict consumer with skipLibCheck: false type-checks (tests/soberania-runtime-consumption.test.mjs).

approvedUse: Private pilot only. AuthorizationRuntime with GovernanceRuntime, CapabilityRuntime and ConsentRuntime; no federated authority; evaluation time from a trusted server clock passed as both `at` and `now`; governance scope, namespace and actor derived server-side. Other exports present in these artifacts (e.g. crypto encryptObject/decryptObject, governance-runtime bootstrap-brief and resource-accounting helpers) are not approved for pilot use.
